'''Grace''' (Japanese: '''グレース''' ''Grace'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|RS}}. She is a [[Pokémon Coordinator]] who competed in the {{to|Fallarbor}} {{pkmn|Contest}}.

==History==
==={{aniseries|RS}}===
Grace debuted in ''[[AG050|Pros and Con Artists]]'', where she was first seen {{pkmn|training}} her {{p|Medicham}} in the [[Fallarbor Town]] [[Pokémon Center]]. {{an|May}} was very impressed, but when she complimented her, Grace's face became red, and she began laughing hysterically. She later sat down with the group for a meal, where she discussed [[Contest combination]] moves.

Grace demonstrated some of her combinations, and May was inspired to practice some of her own techniques with {{TP|May|Beautifly}}. However, May became overwhelmed after [[Drew]] approached her. The next day, she stumbled across {{TRT}}'s fake [[Pokéblock]] store, though Grace arrived in time to expose the trio's scheme and had Medicham send them blasting off.

During the {{pkmn|Contest}} in ''[[AG051|Come What May!]]'', Grace passed the [[Appeal]]s Round and defeated Drew in the [[Contest Battle|Battle Round]]. She eventually battled May in the finals, and they both put up a good fight. However, Beautifly ended up being stronger than Medicham and won, granting May her first Contest [[Ribbon]]. Afterwards, May complimented Grace on her battling skills; once again, her face turned red, and she began laughing.

==Character==
Grace is a very skilled {{pkmn|Coordinator}} who is humble enough to assist in mentoring {{an|May}} for the upcoming [[Fallarbor Town]] {{pkmn|Contest}}. When it comes to compliments, however, Grace tends to turn red and burst into laughter out of embarrassment. She values hard work, having trained both herself and her {{p|Medicham}} to be focused and in sync.

When Grace saw through {{TRT}}'s fake [[Pokéblock]] scam, Medicham was used to free the Pokémon they captured and sent the three blasting off.

In the Fallarbor Town Contest, Medicham got through the [[Appeal]]s Round and battled [[Drew]] and his {{TP|Drew|Roselia}} in the next round, eventually defeating them. Afterwards, it went up against {{an|May}} and her {{TP|May|Beautifly}} in the final round. It showcased its strong concentration and used {{m|Confusion}} to control its opponent's oncoming attacks. Despite this, Beautifly overcame Medicham's strategy and won against it, thus giving May her first [[Ribbon]].
